prompt: A game world is made of $10^2$ chunks, and every chunk holds $10^3$ blocks. How many blocks are in the whole world?
hint: Turn each power of ten into a regular number first.

hints.text: Turn each power of ten into a regular number first.
$10^2 = 100$ chunks and $10^3 = 1{,}000$ blocks each. Now multiply.

explanation: Total blocks $= 100 \times 1{,}000$. Multiplying by $1{,}000$ adds three zeros to $100$.
Notice the shortcut: two zeros plus three zeros gives five zeros, which is $10^5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Add the exponents
steps: That is five tens multiplied together, so $10^5 = 100{,}000$ ✓
